title: Boost Your Brand
content: Boost Your Brand --> --> Connect & Engage with SLAS Year-Round Sponsorships Key to SLAS’s mission is connecting laboratory technology providers with laboratory technology users . There’s no better way to engage top life sciences professionals at leading academic, industry and government organizations than through SLAS. With respected print and online publications, world-class events and exhibitions, and popular virtual education programming, partnering with SLAS is a tremendous way to increase your brand awareness, launch new products and services, fortify existing customer relationships and fill your prospect pipeline with qualified leads. View the Year-Round Visibility Prospectus for opportunities to get in front of the 19,000-strong community. View the SLAS Visibility Prospectus Purchase Non-Event Sales Opportunities Become an SLAS Corporate Partner! Full of benefits and opportunities for technology providers, vendors and companies to gain publicity from and access to the SLAS life sciences community. The Corporate Partner Program now offers two tiers to deliver the benefits that are the most meaningful for your organization. Become a year-long Corporate Partner today! Corporate Partner Program - Tier 1 ($5,500) Tier 1 Corporate Partners will receive: 50 Priority Points towards space selection at the International Conference & Exhibition 50 Priority Points towards space selection at the Europe Conference & Exhibition Corporate Member sign in exhibition booth at the International Conference & Exhibition and Europe Conference & Exhibition 10% discount on sponsored webinars One time per year use of the SLAS email list (opt-in/GDPR compliant list) Participation in the SLAS Corporate Partner Highlight Program – a month-long promotional campaign highlighting all SLAS Corporate Partners on SLAS social media channels and the SLAS weekly Point-to-Point e-newsletter Participation in the SLAS Corporate Partner FYI Talk program, recorded 5-minute informational presentation (audio or video) made available on SLAS APPLIED Listing on the SLAS Corporate Partner Directory Full access to the SLAS Member Directory Free 30-day SLAS Job Board postings for one year Three (3) complimentary Individual Premier Memberships Optional Student Sponsorship add-on for $450 Become a Tier 1 Corporate Partner Corporate Partner Program - Tier 2 ($3,250) Tier 2 Corporate Partners will receive: 25 Priority Points towards space selection at the International Conference & Exhibition 25 Priority Points towards space selection at the Europe Conference & Exhibition Corporate Member sign in exhibition booth at the International Conference & Exhibition and Europe Conference & Exhibition 10% discount on sponsored webinars One time per year use of the SLAS email list (opt-in/GDPR compliant list) Listing on the SLAS Corporate Partner Directory Optional Student Sponsorship add-on for $450 Become a Tier 2 Corporate Partner Optional Student Sponsorship Add-on OPTIONAL ADD-ON: NEXT GENERATION SUPPORT PROGRAM For an additional $450 per year, your organization can sponsor the membership of 10 full-time graduate or undergraduate students pursuing a degree related to life sciences discovery and technology. Your donation will be directly applied to a fund, enabling these students to expand their professional development, build their professional network and take advantage of SLAS educational offerings. Option can be selected during checkout Meet Our Corporate Partners Analytik Jena Automata empowers automation teams to transform their labs into data powerhouses with LINQ, a cloud-native, end-to-end automation platform. LINQ offers a customizable, future-proof solution for automating wet labs, featuring an intuitive software stack for all experience levels and a developer toolkit for advanced users. Its modular, instrument-agnostic lab bench and plate transport system easily scale with lab needs, while cloud-based and in-person support ensure seamless integration. LINQ accelerates innovation in life science labs by scaling output and improving data quality, making it the complete solution for lab automation.
